text:
Ivy: dropped a short review of the compare/catalog mock — focus: filter labels, badge lexicon, pin visibility in multi-collab, and keyboard/a11y nits. figma: https://figma.redwood/compare-scanline

Sam: overall looks polished. two quick calls: 1) badge stacking is hard to scan at 56px row height; 2) pin looks like a state, not an action. feels like we need clearer affordance.

Diego: on badges — can we switch to a single compact "summary chip" that expands inline to show details? e.g., "Perf • 42ms" then click/hover expands to show cost/accuracy chips. reduces visual noise.

Ivy: agree. also thought about the word "signature" in filters. new users keep asking if this is the model id. propose renaming to "Variant signature" with helper tooltip, or split into two filters: "Family" and "Signature".

Harper: pin scope question: current mock persists pins across workspace. for teams that demo, that could be surprising. recommend per-user by default plus a small 'share' toggle in the pin menu that requires confirmation and shows a preview of who will see it.

Sam: microcopy tweak: change pin label from "Pinned - v4" to "Pinned (you) — v4" and for shared pins "Pinned (workspace) — v4". makes owner explicit in dense lists.

QA-Bot: automated check: badge-yellow (#FFCC66) with white text -> contrast 2.7:1. Suggested fixes: darken text to #3E2B00 or use outlined chip with dark label. Also flagged missing aria-describedby on the pin button.

Diego: visual idea — use thin left border color as an indicator instead of full badge fill; keep chip text dark on light background. provides color cue without heavy blocks. will sketch.

Harper: keyboard flow: when opening compare modal, focus should land on first selectable model checkbox. additionally, pressing arrow keys while focused on a row should move between rows; ctrl+enter could toggle pin. document these interactions for QA.

Ivy: note on legend: users asked where perf thresholds come from. propose a small inline legend that reads "Perf (p50): green <50ms • amber 50–150ms • red >150ms" with a link "what this means" to docs. keep legend collapsed by default and keyboard-expandable.

Sam: small accessibility concern: hover expansion currently uses height animation; please ensure prefer-reduced-motion gets an instant expand variant. also add aria-expanded on the chip button.

Diego: for compact mode, show only the summary chip + a tiny icon; comfy mode shows expanded chips by default. persist mode per-user in local settings.

LocaleBot: FYI — when adjusting microcopy, include placeholders for RTL languages and ensure pin labels fit in translations (use dynamic "(you)" placement guarded by i18n).

QA-Bot: additional check: ensure that pin-share confirmation modal traps focus and announces "Pin shared with workspace" on success via role=status live region.

Ivy: proposed decisions: 1) implement summary chip that expands on hover/focus with reduced-motion fallback, 2) outlined/dark-text chips to resolve contrast, 3) pin default = per-user, add explicit share toggle with confirmation and clearer microcopy, 4) add collapsed legend with thresholds + docs link, 5) per-user density toggle (compact/comfy) persisted. any objections?

Harper: no objections. i'll draft keyboard interaction spec and a short acceptance checklist for QA.

Sam: i'll update copy strings and add tooltip variants. Diego, ping me when mock is ready and i'll review contrast tokens.

Diego: I'll post a compact mock + comfy variant in ~2h, includes left-border cue and reduced-motion.

Ivy: thanks! leaving thread open until mock + QA checklist land. :thumbsup:
